reason: I run four or five buses off Excel, the whiteboard and Xero and it works. I've never paid a cent for ops software, and even at 30% off that's about A$125 a month, near A$1,500 a year, to fix double-bookings I don't really have.
objection: Brand new company with no customers. I'm not handing my bookings and drivers to someone who might be gone in a year, and Coach Manager or my telematics already does half of this for less.
would_change_my_mind: Another small operator I know from the bus association meetings telling me it saved them real hours or got them through an accreditation audit without stress.
